observations: Photo 0 shows an LG flat-screen monitor (brand logo visible) with a black keyboard in front.
No visible model number/serial number on the monitor in the photo.
Keyboard appears generic/unknown model; no visible brand/model text in the photo.
No remote is visible in the photo.
Screen condition is not verifiable from a single photo (no close-up of pixels/lines).

claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an LG monitor and a keyboard together.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a pixel test pattern or close-up to confirm dead pixels/lines.
No service label/inspection proof shown; photo cannot confirm repair history.

risks.risk: Remote may not actually be included (or may be missing/incorrect).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/clip showing the remote next to the monitor/keyboard and the remote model/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as monitor+keyboard only (remote not included).

risks.risk: Screen may have hidden faults not visible in the photo (dead pixels, lines, flicker, backlight issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering on with a full-screen solid color test (red/green/blue/white/black) and a scrolling text/line pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed perfect display (worst case: treat as needing inspection).

risks.risk: Keyboard may be incomplete or have non-working keys.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing keyboard connected and typing across the full key range (or a key-test app).
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard condition uncertain (worst case: partial faults).

risks.risk: Monitor model/size is unknown, which drives value.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the monitor model number label (back sticker) and screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable for the closest match (worst case: smaller/older monitor).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the monitor back label showing model number and screen size.
Video: monitor powered on with full-screen color test + line/pattern test (to confirm no dead pixels/lines).
Photo/clip showing the remote included (and its label/model).
Video: keyboard connected and demonstrating typing/key responsiveness.
response.reason: The photo confirms an LG monitor and a keyboard, but the key pricing drivers (exact monitor model/size and whether the remote is included, plus display health) are not verifiable from the single image.
